comments.author: Carbon Black
comments.body_html: There is not an easy way for you to do it. I manually changed each of the inserts by hand and unless you can unpackage my mod, change the exact inserts for the altyn (Which to be fair this is my most professionally organized mod so far tbh so it would be easy to alter), and repackage it for yourself -> then no unfortunately, don’t know how to make it editable.

comments.author: Carbon Black
comments.body_html: I manually changed the inserts by hand. I only had access to the item IDs of the vanilla SPT via SP DB. So only Vanilla SPT items and clones of those items (I mean actually cloned from the info not an item that looks like another like the 6b45 being a 6b43 without shoulder or groin irl, I mean as in functionally the same item in game with the same item TPLs) are affected as each armor is made of individual armor inserts which are all their own items with their own item TPLs. If a mod doesn’t use that specific TPL as a basis, it won’t be affected. In that case, go to that mod and youll have to hope theres a config or DB json you can edit of the items there instead.
